player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Gen''') posted a [[Light]] list on DeckTech in May 2001.
description: Throne Room at it's best...trust me.
cards: posted: There should be an Order to Engage in the decklist. (strategy)
posted: The Bith Shuffle/Desperate Reach x2
posted: Sorry About the Mess/Blaster Prof.
notes: No objective. The author marks his starting cards inline: Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room '(SL)' (starting location), Heading For The Medical Frigate '(SI)' (posted 'HFTMT (SI)'), and Your Insight Serves You Well, Staging Areas and Insurrection '(SE)' (starting Effects). All are in the list and count. Three Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.
The strategy opens 'There should be an Order to Engage in the decklist.' The author says he left it off, so Order To Engage is added: 59 posted + 1 = 60 (section counts 6+20+9+2+19+3 = 59 as posted).

Posted 'Grabber' is kept as written (UNKNOWN): the strategy only says '1 Grabber Brangus Glee...yeah, Brangus Glee', naming the target, not the card. The draft's Allegations Of Corruption is a Coruscant card (after this post).

Posted 'Home OneDB' dested the location Home One: Docking Bay (the draft had the Home One starship, which is listed separately under Ships); 'TatooineDocking Bay' dested the Light Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 (the draft had the Dark page; Mos Espa Docking Bay is a Tatooine-set card, after this post); 'Yavin IVThrone Room' dested Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room.
Posted 'Insurrection (SE)' dested the printed Endor Effect Insurrection (the draft had Insurrection (V)); 'YISYW' dested Your Insight Serves You Well.

Posted 'Wedge Antilles RSL' dested Wedge Antilles, Red Squadron Leader (strategy: 'DSII Wedge'); 'EPP Luke/Leia/Han/Obi' dested Luke With Lightsaber, Leia With Blaster Rifle, Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol and Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'EJP Lando' dested Lando With Vibro-Ax; 'Major Hassh'n' dested Major Haash'n; 'Lt. Blount' dested Lieutenant Blount.

Posted 'Weapon Levitation' dested the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt Weapon Levitation (Jabba's Palace); 'Don't Get @#$%y' dested Don't Get Cocky; 'Run Luke, Run' dested Run Luke, Run!; the slash pairs dested as the combo interrupts.
The author says he should have played this deck at the Washington state championship; he played a different Light deck there (went 1-2), so no event is set.
